REJECT
Even counting only the visible remainder, `RunTurnAsync` still has about 16 points of cognitive complexity: the base-arm and `OnShellsDone` ternaries, the `Broken`/`Unjudged`/`!dryRun` ifs, the `&&` chain with its nested `why` ternary, the `||`/`&&` lambda, and the doubly nested `Covered` ternary in the record; the unseen opening lines, the inner `try`/`catch` and the outer `catch` add more, so it is still above 15.
